alt_text: ANIMBELT FOR MAYA — Built by an animator who got tired.

captions.linkedin:
I built AnimBelt because I was losing hours a week to things Maya should already do.

Pose libraries, retargeting, curve cleanup, camera splits, reference playback - all the small repetitive jobs that sit between you and the part you actually enjoy.

One toolkit. One install. Rs 5,000 one-time, lifetime licence, 2 devices, and it works across Maya 2022 to 2027.

→ Buy AnimBelt: https://mythicalmotions.com/animbelt
→ Free mentorship demo: https://mythicalmotions.com/mentorship
→ Everything else: https://mythicalmotions.com
→ Free animator Discord: https://discord.gg/suMy2Z7CHa
